correctness.rationale: Finite tcl-closed colored rooted subtrees are uniquely classified by a mandatory rooted subtree per label-1 child and arbitrary finite multisets of subtrees per infinity child. The stated Pólya exponent/product recursion follows by induction on plan height. If infinity plan nodes are an antichain, each contributes a free nonnegative multiplicity with fixed size s_sigma, giving the rational product and simplex lattice-point cumulative asymptotic. A nested pair yields branch types of sizes b+cj and at least 2^k distinct multisets of O(k^2) total size, hence exp(c sqrt N) cumulative lower bound. Induction on height shows F_sigma(r)<infinity for all 0<r<1, implying log A(N)=o(N); superpolynomial growth excludes rationality. Empty infinity plan/d=0 case explicitly handled.

originality.rationale: Mirabi 2023 defines the exact colored generic tree, closure operator and polynomial-size uniform finite approximants. His cardinality polynomial |Gamma(m)| counts vertices of special finite approximants, not isomorphism types of all tcl-closed finite subtrees graded by size; the depth-two infinity plan demonstrates the distinction (1+m+m^2 vs partition numbers). Falque–Thiéry 2020 classify polynomial subset-orbit profiles rather than this closure-cardinality invariant. Classical unlabeled multiset/partition tools are credited. No inspected stronger theorem gives the complete infinity-node comparability dichotomy; equivalence in age/Pólya theory remains a risk.
